newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom to hike mobile investments.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom to hike mobile investments.

text.p: France Telecom is set to invest more than three billion francs ($586.9 million) in 1997 to double the number of relay stations for its Itineris GSM mobile telecommunications network.

Michel Bertinetto, head of France Telecom Mobiles, said the number of relay stations in France should reach 6,000 at the end of 1997 from 3,000 at the end of 1996, which means that in one year France Telecom will add as many stations as it built "since the start of services in 1992."
France Telecom has invested 10 billion francs in its Itineris network since 1992.
"In 1996, investments will be some three billion francs and in 1997 I think they will be more than three billion francs," he said.
Itineris currently has 1.15 million subscribers and aims to have 1.25 million subscribers at the end of the year.
"For the year 2000, the objective is to have five million subscribers," Bertinetto said.
